title: Sanctions fear reversal -> long RCL 5d
hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Reversal test: GDELT sanctions GKG share 20d z-score > 1 marks peak-fear, after which cruise operators rebound (+); trade long RCL 5d at 5d lag [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.RCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0068)
message: Not supported: sanctions-fear reversal into RCL fails OOS (war test 8 trades, avg -1.7%, excess -1.3%); pre-war fit +0.6% excess only; validity 0, actionability 3.1

trade_idea.entry_rule: gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long RCL next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 5 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [fuel-airspace-losers] Sign flip of R2-0167: in the war regime sanctions fear persists rather than reverses; GDELT sanctions GKG share 20d z-score > 1 leads cruise weakness by 3 days (-); trade short CCL 3d [gdelt.gkg.sanctions_share -> finance.CCL.log_return] (parent: R2-0167)
